setup.title: Start from zero. Build a global airline.
setup.copy: Choose a small commercial base airport, operate in UTC, use real ICAO codes and grow through contracts, aircraft, staff and routes.
setup.zeroBudgetNote: Every airline starts with a zero balance. Initial money will come from contracts, loans, missions or other game mechanics later.

dashboard.mapCopy: This first prototype uses a styled placeholder. The next step is to connect MapLibre GL JS and draw real aircraft markers, airports and routes.
dashboard.nextStepCopy: Connect the airport seed to MySQL, then replace the placeholder map with MapLibre GL JS.
